content:
TEMPTATION ||| Lean closer, brushing my wrist against his scarred skin ||| "Let's make them wonder what we're up to."  
BOUNDARY ||| Step back, pulling my hand away from his grip ||| "I won't answer your questions here, not like this."  
CONFESSION ||| Hold his gaze, my heart racing in the silence ||| "I feel exposed, and you know it."  
REVERSAL ||| Square my shoulders, taking ownership of the moment ||| "I won't let you dictate my truth any longer."  
SILENCE ||| Stand still, letting the tension fill the air ||| *A breath escapes me.*
